goal: Ship the example bundle: okflify documents itself as an OKF bundle
learning_prompts: What broke or slowed this release?
What proof was missing until late?
Which gate should become automatic next time?
Which human approval should remain explicit?
notes: Pushed b2e59cd..4c4d90f to eidos-agi/okflify master via Hancock, since shipr's model lists 'public publish/tag' as an approval gate. LEARNINGS — (1) What broke: nothing at ship time, but the evidence page nearly shipped invented counts; chasing a 12-vs-10 edge discrepancy exposed a real resolver bug. Numbers you did not measure are how bugs hide. (2) Proof missing until late: pytest and ruff are named in the release model and NEITHER IS INSTALLED; the repo has no test suite, so 3 of 4 named proofs are aspirational. The proof that actually held was a build + a DOM assertion in a real browser. (3) Gate that should become automatic: the build must run on both the example bundle AND a large catalogue before any push — that pair caught the regression risk. (4) Approval that must stay explicit: the public push. It reached the internet on a human signature and should keep doing so.
